doc.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022

title: Ruth Brisbane and touring Europe and Russia
summary: Blue remembers vocalist Ruth Brisbane and tours of Denmark, Sweden and a 12-day Russian tour in December.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: A pig foot and a bottle of beer! Okay. You know it’s all true, what you said. It is true. She had all of it. Yeah. The church, the pig foot, and the bottle of beer, she had it all. And she could bring it man. She could simply bring it. And she was a sweetheart. I really loved her. And when it was time for her to sing man, I’d lay back and just listen you know, and it inspired notes for me to play underneath her too, you know, the way she did it, it fit that tenor sound. Yeah. And that was wonderful. We did some tours, the tours that we did, when I was with them we were in Europe a few times, Denmark, Sweden. We had like a 12-day tour in Russia in December. You know something? It was colder in New York that year in December than it was in Russia at that time. Yeah. Yeah. It was colder here. But it was a great — we played, the venues were amazing. I mean concert halls, yeah. They had us in concert halls, flew us. Well Russia is huge anyway. Oh man, you know you fly for three or four hours, then you take an overnight train, and you’re still in Russia. Those kind of things. Yeah, it was great. It was great.
Yeah I give Dr. Vollmer a lot of credit for the audaciousness of sort of what he does in handling the logistics and all of that. There’s a lot of passion there.
